title: Accepting circuit encodings with prefixes
statement: The language consists of exactly those Boolean strings that encode a pair of a Boolean list $x$ and a directed acyclic circuit $C$ with $n$ inputs, where every gate has fan-in at most two, $n$ is at most the length of $x$, and evaluating $C$ on the first $n$ entries of $x$—using false for any missing entry—yields true.
